subject: Water coming through the ceiling!!
body:
Hi,

There is water leaking through the bathroom ceiling in flat 2A, it started an hour ago and it's getting worse. I've put a bucket down but it's dripping onto the light fitting.

Please send someone today.

Ruth

subject: Smell of gas
body:
Hello, I was visiting a friend at Millbrook House this evening and there is a strong smell of gas on the landing outside flat 7. I don't live there but thought someone should know.

James Whitmore

subject: Heating
body:
Hello,

The radiators in my flat (unit 12) have been cold since Sunday. The boiler shows error code F28. It's getting quite cold at night.

Thanks,
Hana Sato

subject: Kitchen tap
body:
Hi there, the kitchen tap in 5C drips constantly, even when fully closed. Not urgent, but it's wasting water. Any day next week works for me.

Leo

subject: Question about my rent
body:
Hi, can you confirm the new monthly rent after the April review? I want to update my standing order.

Owen Price, flat 7

subject: Shop front door won't lock
body:
Good morning,

The front door lock at our cafe in unit 4B is broken - the key turns but the bolt doesn't move. We can't secure the premises tonight.

Maja Lindqvist
Copperleaf Coffee

subject: Light in hallway
body:
Hi, the ceiling light in my hallway flickers and then switches off. Changed the bulb, same problem. Unit 12.

Hana
